stem:
Shreya multiplies \((-3) \times 4 \times (-5)\).

Which claims keep the same product? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: Report the word product as the value of the calculation.
The factors are −3, 4 and −5, so the product equals −3 because that is the first printed number.

teacher.key_rationale: Integer multiplication is commutative and associative, so reordering and regrouping keep the product. Naming product is not a value. Copying the first printed factor ignores the product.
